findings.topic: Audio sound coding is imported independently from audio precision and frequency
findings.evidence: Audio imports its own sound compression UID through the sound descriptor interface, converts it to coding representation, maps it to native AudioCodingFormat, and retains sound essence coding separately. QuantizationBits and AudioSamplingRate are distinct reads. The prior converter artifact also clears byte7 of its selected label comparisons; do not confuse that with zeroing the last byte or a general instruction to loosen Bella exact catalogue matching.

An essence-container identifier is not interchangeable with PictureEssenceCoding/SoundEssenceCoding or a human-readable Compression label. Native publication symbol spelling differs from standard raw MXF PictureEssenceCoding/SoundEssenceCompression and from readable codec-toolkit Lua PictureEssenceCoding/SoundEssenceCoding metadata names. preservationBoundary.userRequirement: Keep current Compression naming system. Reuse existing pure compressionNames+dnxnames unchanged with equivalent correctly qualified inputs; preserve companion audio/normalization/legacy-clock behavior outside the pure resolver as well.
preservationBoundary.compactIntegration: Small format-specific own-descriptor acquisition -> compact existing semantic facts -> existing pure resolver. One shared WAV/AIFF summary decode supplies independently usable audio codec/representation, frequency and depth. Numeric Bella depth can create temporary compatibility strings when calling existing resolver. No permanent raw graph/candidate history/per-column class or catalogue rewrite required.
preservationBoundary.publicOutput: Preserve exact strings, spacing, capitalization and bracketed DNx aliases in existing table/CSV. New/Old/ReallyOld DNx results remain available for existing consumers; no new visible column proposed.
preservationBoundary.ownership: Safely established physical file own descriptor; master names, filenames/extensions, PMR membership and loaded bins are not codec identity.

currentAcquisition.fact: Full DIDD:EssenceCompression is selected with uniqueRaw and normalized from16-byte structured AUID memory order into UL octets using established object order. No codec-family prefix matching.

If coding property is absent and own DIDResolutionID converts to an explicitly listed registered resolution, knownDnxLabel provides a coding identity. IDs1235/1237/1238/1241/1242/1243/1244/1250/1251/1252/1253 are explicitly listed; intervening IDs are not admitted arithmetically.

Legacy FourCC table receives DIDD:Compression only as omfi:String of exact4bytes or5includingfinalNUL, and DIDResolutionID as complete4-byte Long/Int32/UInt32; descriptor class must match. Numeric header fields use their declared generic type/order.

Naming geometry uses stored width and stored height converted to frame height for layout1, and legacyOMF1 layout3. It is not automatically the newly selected visible display raster. Inputs also include own MDFL raw rate, FrameLayout, CDCI ComponentWidth and horizontal/vertical subsampling.

A narrow naming-only decimal-to-exact clock helper is applied only for listed DIDResolutionID/profile pairs. It is separate from the accepted Avid Duration/FrameRate interpreter and must not be replaced by a broader interpreted rate that creates new historical aliases.

DNxUncompressed naming consumes interpreted own numeric depth/representation. The accepted generic BitDepth fixed10.6/12.4 label withholding must not erase existing Compression16-bit fixed-point descriptions; preserve separate necessary interpretation facts for this contract.

A sole-alpha own RGBA layout plus explicit NONE and established missing coding can supply uncompressed-alpha name. Alpha presence or absent coding alone is insufficient. Separate RLE-coded labels keep their existing exact names.

WAVD/contextualWAVE own matching fmt uses formatTag1 ->PCM and3 ->IEEE float. Extensible requires recognized full PCM/IEEE SubFormat; unknown/invalid required subtype stays unsupported/unreadable rather than name from storage or container. AIFD own COMM has known integer/float codes; compressionName is descriptive and does not identify the codec.

Ordinary AIFF legitimately lacks compressionType and is PCM. AIFF-C requires its code: absent/truncated/unreadable required code is not a PCM default. Current low-level reader receives the FORM kind, creates explicit unreadable extension fields, while the projector infers ordinary-AIFF PCM from no codecProperty. Bella shared compact helper should retain form distinction directly.

Current audio Summary codec facts are emitted independently of shared compressionNames; an unchanged name catalogue alone would not preserve all audio behavior. Missing descriptive AIFF-C name can preserve PCM if in24 is complete; unknown encoding code retains no supported codec name.

Selected Compression is stored as QString in row, displayed/exported unchanged and sorted case-insensitively. Current already-read eligible OMF/MXF results outrank MDB for Compression; prior preservation decision retains this preference without deciding new file-open triggers.

exactNameDecisionOrder: Known exact DNx profile -> NewDnx/OldDnx and current compression NewDnx; append bracketed historical name only at an exact supported operating point (raster/layout/depth/subsampling/clock). Missing alias does not erase established DNx profile name.
Exact standard/fixed DNxUncompressed label -> Avid DNxUncompressed; add the current depth/representation phrase only when qualified inputs are available.
Exact catalogue label -> existing descriptive name, returned before legacy fallback. This preserves currently supported family-level names when the label cannot establish a finer preset/bitrate.
Exact supported generic uncompressed coding -> name only when own alpha or CDCI component/subsampling facts justify current explicit name.

Exact supported JPEG2000 coding -> JPEG2000 family; existing HD refinement only for its exact generic label and matched raster/layout/depth/subsampling/clock combinations. No unproved preset from label alone.

Typed supported legacy class/FourCC/resolution tuple may supply name only for genuinely absent coding or its explicitly compatible full coding ID; present unrelated/unknown coding does not unlock this fallback. Legacy names can remain DV/Avid Packed/MPEG-2 without unsupported standard/component refinements.

Explicit uncompressed sole-alpha/NONE with established missing coding -> current1:1 Alpha8/10bit or Uncompressed alpha. Known PCMA/contextualWAVE with established missing coding -> currentPCM fallback.
Otherwise name is empty, producing blank if no eligible source supplies it. There is no universal literal Unknown fallback and no raw FourCC/filename/prefix-only label invented.
staticRisksAndUnknowns: Current auidToUl checks read state/16bytes/order but not expected declared GUID type. Generic integer conversion can accept other decoded numeric-compatible types. Bella required known native type/width qualification must be explicit, without calling this an observed incorrect actual label.

Current knownDnX resolution recovery tests codingAbsent before source completeness is applied; legacy fallback uses codingAbsent&&completeObject. An incomplete read could therefore recover a DNx profile from apparent absence more readily than legacy fallback. No damaged specimen or wrong label was demonstrated. Existing agreed established-absence requirements should not be described as current universal enforcement.

Current contextual WAVE can emit Summary-derived IEEEfloat and generic class-based PCM when coding is absent, causing equal-rank disagreement; no actual WAVE-descriptor specimen is established. Supported WAVD/AIFD actual behavior must be preserved; any contextual override needs explicit policy rather than pretending current parity was demonstrated.

Do not feed display-visible resolution in place of stored naming geometry, interpreted/rounded frame label in place of naming raw clock, reduced coding prefix in place of full identifier, or blank generic BitDepth in place of still-required fixed-point Compression context.
A missing refinement should retain established current family name. Do not turn missing technical columns into a blanket condition that erases known Compression.

TIFD BitDepth is deliberately unavailable in release one, but this does not erase an independently supported exact TIFF coding name. MPGA class alone does not establish MP2 versus MP3; no broad class/family default was added.

PMR is not a Compression-value source. Sharing a name resolver across OMF/MDB/MXF does not guarantee identical names when available/qualified facts differ. No new physical-file PMR/MDB/OMF parity comparison or runtime output test was performed.

rootCurationProgram.source:
"""Curate OMF Compression review from bounded receipts; no media/app execution."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/Users/martymclean/Developer/MediaMuster')
CACHE = {}
verified, unavailable, captures, updated_plans = {}, [], {}, []


def sha(path):
    p = Path(path)
    key = str(p)
    if key not in CACHE:
        h = hashlib.sha256()
        with p.open('rb') as stream:
            for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
                h.update(block)
        CACHE[key] = h.hexdigest()
    return CACHE[key]


def record(path):
    p = Path(path)
    return {'path': str(p), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(p)}


def check(path, expected, context):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.is_absolute():
        p = ROOT / p
    if not p.is_file():
        unavailable.append({'path': str(p), 'expectedSha256': expected, 'context': context})
        return
    actual = sha(p)
    if (p == ROOT / 'Project Bella/README.md' and actual != expected
            and context.startswith('current/priorDecisionsAndResearch/')):
        updated_plans.append({'path': str(p), 'receiptTimeSha256': expected,
                              'currentSha256': actual,
                              'reason': 'Mutable plan received the OMF Compression proposal during this review; not asserted unchanged.'})
        return
    assert actual == expected, (str(p), expected, actual, context)
    verified[str(p)] = {'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': actual}
    if str(p).startswith('/private/tmp/') and p.suffix == '.txt' and p.stat().st_size <= 200000:
        captures[str(p)] = {'sha256': actual, 'text': p.read_text()}


def walk(value, context):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for pk, hk in [('path', 'sha256'), ('artifact', 'artifactSha256'),
                       ('resolvedArtifact', 'resolvedArtifactSha256')]:
            if isinstance(value.get(pk), str) and isinstance(value.get(hk), str):
                check(value[pk], value[hk], context)
        for key, child in value.items():
            if context == 'current' and key == 'sourceAnchors':
                continue
            walk(child, context + '/' + str(key))
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for index, child in enumerate(value):
            walk(child, context + '/' + str(index))


expected_receipts = {
    'mc': '05daac9c2ee4fa3c76213e1cafb80e7aa925939f8c239699b81339c1c1cc53f9',
    'mdvx': '42ec23c51ff12e4dcfd0a3be640b273c926d9bf3eb295a79471362be4caf9f30',
    'current': '0bff60f7d82bcc461351c9361c7a68de93cd249cc5a22b9ea0a991e5a0078457',
}
receipts, receipt_files = {}, {}
for who, expected in expected_receipts.items():
    p = Path(f'/private/tmp/bella-omf-compression-{who}-20261025/findings.json')
    assert sha(p) == expected
    receipt_files[who] = record(p)
    receipts[who] = json.loads(p.read_text())
    walk(receipts[who], who)

current = receipts['current']
assert len(current['sourceInputs']) == 16
for source in current['sourceInputs']:
    p = Path(source['path'])
    relative = str(p.relative_to(ROOT))
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + relative], cwd=ROOT) == p.read_bytes()
assert len(current['sourceAnchors']) == 44
for anchor in current['sourceAnchors']:
    lines = Path(anchor['path']).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
    text = ''.join(lines[anchor['startLine'] - 1:anchor['endLine']])
    assert text == anchor['text']
    assert hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() == anchor['sha256']

mdvx_ranges, native_slots = [], []
mdvx = receipts['mdvx']
with Path(mdvx['binary']['path']).open('rb') as stream:
    for method in mdvx['freshFunctions'] + mdvx['reusedFunctions']:
        stream.seek(method['binaryOffset'])
        raw = stream.read(method['codeBytes'])
        assert len(raw) == method['codeBytes']
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == method['codeSha256']
        mdvx_ranges.append({k: method[k] for k in ['symbol', 'binaryOffset', 'codeBytes', 'codeSha256']})
assert len(mdvx_ranges) == 17
assert len(receipts['mc']['freshFunctions']) == 10
for block in receipts['mc']['freshStreamSlotsDecoded']:
    with Path(block['binary']).open('rb') as stream:
        for slot in block['slots']:
            stream.seek(slot['fileOffset'])
            assert stream.read(8).hex() == slot['rawHex']
            native_slots.append(slot)
assert len(native_slots) == 7

# Reanalyse saved own-descriptor observations only; no physical media opens.
raw_path = Path('/private/tmp/bella-omf-observed-20261023/findings.json')
depth_path = Path('/private/tmp/bella-omf-bit-depth-observed-20261025/findings.json')
raw = json.loads(raw_path.read_text())
depth = json.loads(depth_path.read_text())
examples = []
for own in depth['files']:
    original = next(f for f in raw['files'] if f['path'] == own['path'])
    example = {k: own[k] for k in ['path', 'fullFileMobId', 'fileOwnerObject', 'descriptorObject', 'descriptorClass']}
    example['freshPhysicalReadThisReview'] = False
    if own['descriptorClass'] == 'WAVD':
        prefix = bytes.fromhex(own['sourcePrefixHex'])
        assert int.from_bytes(prefix[:2], 'little') == 1
        example.update({'formatTag': 1, 'prefixHex': prefix.hex(),
                        'interpretation': 'Supported own PCM WAVE format tag; current naming consequence PCM, not an observed current app cell.'})
    elif own['descriptorClass'] == 'AIFD':
        prefix = bytes.fromhex(own['freshCommonPrefixHex'])
        assert prefix[18:22] == b'in24'
        example.update({'compressionType': 'in24', 'prefixHex': prefix.hex(),
                        'interpretation': 'Supported own AIFF-C encoding code; current naming consequence PCM. Prefix was checked during Bit Depth review, not reopened here; not app output.'})
    else:
        props = [p for p in original['selectedSmallRawProperties']
                 if p['object'] == own['descriptorObject']
                 and p['propertyName'] in ['OMFI:DIDD:Compression', 'OMFI:DIDD:DIDResolutionID']]
        assert len(props) == 2
        code = next(p for p in props if p['propertyName'] == 'OMFI:DIDD:Compression')
        resolution = next(p for p in props if p['propertyName'] == 'OMFI:DIDD:DIDResolutionID')
        assert code['typeName'] == 'omfi:String' and code['length'] == 5
        code_bytes = bytes.fromhex(code['hex'])
        assert len(code_bytes) == 5 and code_bytes[-1] == 0
        assert resolution['typeName'] == 'omfi:Long' and resolution['length'] == 4
        example.update({'legacyCompression': code_bytes[:4].decode('ascii'),
                        'resolutionId': int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(resolution['hex']), 'little', signed=True),
                        'recordedProperties': props,
                        'interpretation': 'Saved own legacy identifiers only; no new catalogue execution, missing-coding proof, image decode or app label derived from filename/depth.'})
    examples.append(example)
assert [(e.get('legacyCompression'), e.get('resolutionId')) for e in examples[2:]] == [('JFIF', 110), ('AVHD', 1243), ('MPG2', 160)]

bit_plan_path = ROOT / 'Project Bella/evidence/omf-bit-depth-plan-2026-10-25.json'
bit_plan = json.loads(bit_plan_path.read_text())
check(bit_plan['researchAtApproval']['path'], bit_plan['researchAtApproval']['sha256'], 'bitDepthApproval/research')
assert not unavailable, unavailable

rules = {
    'status': 'Current naming preservation already accepted/reaffirmed; detailed OMF acquisition/integration recommendations under review. No runtime or cutover.',
    'ownerAndScope': 'Qualified physical file own descriptor/owned supported summaries; agreed OMF/Bento1 scope and full-ID qualification. No master/source codec substitutes, new type aliases, QT/native-enum mapper or TIFF decoder.',
    'nameResolver': 'Keep CompressionFacts/compressionNames and dnxnames catalogue/decision order unchanged. Supply equivalent supported compact facts; preserve names, branding, exact historical aliases, family fallbacks, unknown/ambiguous outcomes and app/export outputs.',
    'coding': 'Full supported structured16-byte DIDD:EssenceCompression, correctly type/order-normalized to resolver label. No blind on-disk UL assumption, prefix match or version-byte rewrite. Present unknown/unreadable/damaged/conflicting required coding is not absence.',
    'legacy': 'Own typed DIDD:Compression String4 or5-with-terminal-zero and own typed4-byte DIDResolutionID in known numeric order. Preserve finite code/class/ID/coding-compatible mappings and verified absent-coding DNx-ID recovery only with established relevant completeness. MobId length and filename are unrelated.',
    'nativeBoundary': 'Native DIDCompressMethod Char4 is separate from serialized DIDD:Compression String. No new Bella alias. Native zero-to-NONE defaults, writer VCID transforms, low16 WAVE subtype shortcut and PCMA/MDAU AudioCodingFormat enums are not copied into naming rules.',
    'auxiliaryFacts': 'Preserve own stored naming geometry/field-height handling, naming clock plus narrow legacy DNx naming-only decimal interpretation, layout, raw component width/subsampling and necessary representation/alpha details. No inference from display columns or change to accepted Duration/Frame Rate maths. Existing approved J2K correction unchanged.',
    'audio': 'Decode own supported WAVD/AIFD summary once with Sample Rate/Bit Depth. Known WAVE format tag/full qualified extensible subtype and trueAIFF versus requiredAIFF-C code choose current PCM/IEEEfloat names. Human-readable AIFC description and container name are not encoding authority. Required bad/unknown encoding never becomes guessed PCM.',
    'guardedFallbacks': 'Narrow PCMA/contextualWAVE class/absence PCM fallback only if applicable required encoding context qualifies; never override known float or bypass required owned-summary code. No blanket audio/MPGA->PCM/MP2/MP3. Preserve OMF explicitNONE+qualifiedsolealpha; no MXF partition-marker rule transplant.',
    'independentDetail': 'Known family can remain named when only optional refinement is unavailable. Blank generic Bit Depth does not erase compact format details needed by Compression or settle open uncommon fixed-point generic labels. Generate transient compatible depth/format strings only as needed.',
    'retention': 'Keep owned current Compression and existing naming outputs required by app/export. Retain compact raw facts only for other agreed results; release temporary naming facts, raw summaries/indexes/graphs. Small adapter and ordinary shared functions; no per-column parser/class/registry/candidate history/dependency.',
    'readingAndPriorities': 'No extra file open, essence decode or source-policy change. Already accepted eligible already-read OMF/MXF preference over MDB stays; full priorities/opening/scheduling later. No claim all MDB/OMF same-file names agree or measured speed/memory/stability gain.',
}
out = {
    'schemaVersion': 1, 'date': '2026-10-25', 'timezone': 'Australia/Sydney',
    'status': rules['status'],
    'currentHead': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
    'userInstructions': {'bitDepthAccepted': bit_plan['authorization']['statement'],
                         'compressionNaming': 'Keep the current naming system.'},
    'bitDepthApproval': record(bit_plan_path),
    'proposedBellaAcquisitionAndIntegration': rules,
    'publicPrimaryEvidence': [
        {'title': 'Apple AIFF-C Common Chunk', 'url': 'https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/mac/Sound/Sound-83.html', 'checked': '2026-10-25', 'scope': 'Compression code separate from descriptive name; supported format meaning is not a generic codec dictionary.'},
        {'title': 'Microsoft WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE', 'url': 'https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/mmreg/ns-mmreg-waveformatextensible', 'checked': '2026-10-25', 'scope': 'Extensible tag and typed SubFormat distinguish encodings; required extension meaning is not established by container tag alone.'},
    ],
    'receiptFiles': receipt_files, 'nativeAndCurrentReceipts': receipts,
    'artifactTextCaptures': captures,
    'reusedPhysicalMetadata': {'sourceReceipts': [record(raw_path), record(depth_path)],
                               'examples': examples,
                               'boundary': 'Five saved qualified own-descriptor examples. No media read in this Compression review. Input facts/illustrative supported audio interpretations only; no new runtime/table/MDB-OMF comparison or full absent-coding proof for video.'},
    'rootCurationProgram': {**record(__file__), 'source': Path(__file__).read_text()},
    'rootVerification': {'referencedFilesRehashed': verified, 'unavailableFreshInputs': unavailable,
                         'planningInputsUpdatedDuringReview': updated_plans,
                         'mdvxCodeRangesRehashed': mdvx_ranges, 'nativeStreamSlotsRechecked': native_slots,
                         'nativeFreshMethodArtifactsHashed': 10,
                         'sourceFilesEqualHead': 16, 'sourceAnchorHashesVerified': 44,
                         'freshPhysicalMediaReads': 0, 'reusedPhysicalPaths': 5,
                         'nativeAppsOrPrivateApisExecuted': False, 'productionParserExecuted': False,
                         'runtimeCodeChanged': False, 'testsOrBuildsExecuted': False, 'performanceMeasured': False},
    'independentDraftReviews': {'native': 'Passed, no material correction.',
                                'mdvx': 'Passed, no material correction.',
                                'currentSource': 'Passed after making PCM fallback qualification explicit: never bypass required encoding or override known float. Static equal-rank current WAVE case is not an observed bad specimen.'},
    'limits': ['Bounded native read/write methods are not universal GUI naming behavior; historical raw references in prior curated evidence are not asserted freshly recovered.',
               'MDVx generic OMFI enrichment/naming does not prove standalone physical OMF fallback or complete per-codec dictionary coverage.',
               'Source/test inspection only. Broader scalar/type/absence handling and competing WAVE PCM/float route are static limits, not demonstrated wrong file labels.',
               'Five reused metadata examples do not establish all codec/layout/writer/damage coverage or universal MDB/OMF naming parity.',
               'No native apps/private APIs, builds/tests, production parser, media writes, extra header opens, Bella runtime/cutover or performance comparison.']
}
destination = ROOT / 'Project Bella/evidence/omf-compression-2026-10-25.json'
destination.write_text(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'evidence': str(destination), 'bytes': destination.stat().st_size,
                  'referencedFilesRehashed': len(verified), 'textCaptures': len(captures),
                  'sourceFilesEqualHead': 16, 'sourceAnchors': 44,
                  'mdvxCodeRanges': len(mdvx_ranges), 'nativeStreamSlots': len(native_slots),
                  'freshMediaReads': 0, 'reusedPhysicalPaths': 5}))
